metadata.name: CyRECS Technique
metadata.value: CR-IA-01

metadata.name: Attack Focus

metadata.name: Targets

metadata.name: Attack Mechanics

techniques.comment: CR-IA-01 — Phishing-driven workstation compromise used to gain an initial foothold in PSAP/IT networks.

metadata.name: CyRECS Technique
metadata.value: CR-IA-02

metadata.name: Attack Focus
metadata.value: Trusted supplier relationship abused to introduce malicious software/firmware into NG911 components.

metadata.name: Targets
metadata.value: ESInet; NGCS; BCF; ESRP; ECRF; LIS; LVF

metadata.name: Attack Mechanics
metadata.value: Trojanized updates/components → privileged execution within functional elements → persistent control and integrity risk.

techniques.comment: CR-IA-02 — Compromised vendor software/firmware delivered through trusted update channels into NG911 functional elements.

metadata.name: CyRECS Technique
metadata.value: CR-IA-03

metadata.name: Attack Focus
metadata.value: Legacy ingress via protocol conversion path into ESInet service plane.

metadata.name: Targets
metadata.value: LNG; LPG; ESInet

metadata.name: Attack Mechanics
metadata.value: Crafted/hostile legacy signaling reaches LNG → translated onward → parsing/interop edge cases exploited.

metadata.name: Related Playbook
metadata.value: playbooks/legacy_protocol_injection.md

techniques.comment: CR-IA-03 — Legacy ingress through LNG/LPG conversion path to inject hostile signaling into NG911 workflows.

metadata.name: CyRECS Technique
metadata.value: CR-IA-04 (optional/extension)

metadata.name: Attack Focus
metadata.value: Public-facing service exploitation on edge or externally reachable components.

metadata.name: Targets
metadata.value: BCF/SBC; ESRP; ECRF; LIS; LVF (if exposed/misconfigured)

metadata.name: Attack Mechanics

techniques.comment: CR-IA-04 — Exploitation of exposed services on edge NG911 components (only when publicly reachable/misconfigured).

metadata.name: CyRECS Techniques
metadata.value: CR-ID-01; CR-ID-02

metadata.name: Attack Focus
metadata.value: Identity and trust-assertion manipulation used to misrepresent caller/service identity.

metadata.name: Targets
metadata.value: BCF; ESRP; PSAP; LIS; LVF; ECRF

metadata.name: Attack Mechanics
metadata.value: CR-ID-01: SIP identity/ANI spoofing via INVITE header manipulation. CR-ID-02: LIS impersonation and forged PIDF-LO/location assertions.

metadata.name: Related Playbooks
metadata.value: playbooks/caller_id_spoof.md; playbooks/lis_impersonation.md

techniques.comment: CR-ID-01/02 — Identity manipulation: SIP caller identity spoofing and LIS impersonation/forged location assertions.

metadata.name: CyRECS Technique
metadata.value: CR-PA-01

metadata.name: Attack Focus
metadata.value: Transport security weakened via downgrade/negotiation manipulation when configurations allow it.

metadata.name: Targets
metadata.value: ALL_ESINET_SERVICES

metadata.name: Attack Mechanics
metadata.value: Handshake/negotiation pressure → weak TLS/cipher selection (where misconfigured) → interception/modification opportunities.

techniques.comment: CR-PA-01 — Protocol downgrade/weak negotiation exposure enabling interception or manipulation on ESInet services.

metadata.name: CyRECS Technique

metadata.value: Software weakness exploitation in routing/location services to gain elevated execution or trigger failures.

metadata.name: Targets
metadata.value: ESRP; ECRF; LIS; LVF

metadata.name: Attack Mechanics
metadata.value: Malformed inputs or unpatched weaknesses → remote code execution or privilege gain (varies by component).

techniques.comment: CR-VE-01 — Exploit software weaknesses in core NG911 services for elevated execution or destabilization.

metadata.name: CyRECS Technique
metadata.value: CR-PA-02

metadata.name: Attack Focus
metadata.value: Capture call media/metadata where media segments are unprotected.

metadata.name: Targets
metadata.value: Media paths touching LPG; PSAP; logging/recording segments

metadata.name: Attack Mechanics
metadata.value: Sniff unencrypted media segments or weakly protected links to capture audio/metadata.

techniques.comment: CR-PA-02 — Media path observation: call media/metadata capture on unprotected segments.

metadata.name: CyRECS Technique

metadata.name: Targets
metadata.value: LPG; PSAP; LOGGING_SERVICE

metadata.name: CyRECS Technique
metadata.value: CR-CO-01

metadata.name: Attack Focus

metadata.name: Targets
metadata.value: LIS; PSAP_BACKEND; LOGGING_SERVICE

metadata.name: Attack Mechanics

metadata.name: CyRECS Techniques
metadata.value: CR-SD-01; CR-SD-02; CR-SD-03

metadata.name: Attack Focus
metadata.value: Service disruption via signaling floods, query exhaustion, and induced gateway isolation.

metadata.name: Targets
metadata.value: BCF; ESRP; PSAP; LPG; LNG; LIS; LVF; ECRF

metadata.name: Attack Mechanics
metadata.value: CR-SD-01: SIP INVITE/call floods (TDoS). CR-SD-02: LIS/LVF/ECRF query floods. CR-SD-03: LPG/LNG induced isolation affecting legacy-dependent PSAPs.

techniques.comment: CR-SD-01/02/03 — Disruption via floods/exhaustion: signaling overload, location/query service exhaustion, and gateway isolation.
